purpose: bounded private image-access and decoding pilot before any quantitative external inference
selection_rule: Within each native recording bucket, sort ascending by (SHA256(UTF-8(selection_seed + ":" + str(native_integer_image_id))).hexdigest(), native_integer_image_id); take 10 from each non-null key and 14 from the null bucket; night only; no GT/model use

transport.required: For each archive GET, require status206 and Content-Range matching the requested bytes and a fixed total size; otherwise stop before reading its body. Every body byte read, including failures, counts toward the cap.
transport.stable_identity: Pin the numeric total size from the first206; every partial response must report that total. Pin ETag/Last-Modified when supplied; a changed value stops the run before reading its body.

checks: Exact selected member mapping or stop; no substituted frames
Native PNG decode and annotation dimensions
Byte/time cap includes failed response bodies; private files only
exclusions: All 64 planned pilot image paths excluded from later quantitative image pool regardless of retrieval success; no head outputs or target tuning
stop: Stop at completion, first transport/identity/CRC/decode failure, or cap; preserve partial evidence without an upload/repair loop
licence: Accepted research licence; citation and no redistribution apply. Only the listed private image-access pilot is now authorized.
authorization: Explicit project instruction on 2026-11-13 authorizes the reviewed64-image/150MB/30minlocalCPU pilot; no GPU, Colab, inference or fullarchive fallback
